title: Explain why you'd want to participate
description:
From Andrew during our meeting: 

> Would be great to have an early sentence or two about WHY we think you should give pydy tuesday a try

Possible angles:

* Up-skilling, chance to explore a particular tool or skillset
   * New skills: Try something you haven't done before
   * Practice: Put in the reps, eg practice pandas 
* Portfolio building
   * Share with others

title: repo for PyDyTuesday python package
description:
Hi there!

Thanks for this project, I believe it's a valuable addition to the tidytuesday. 

I was wondering, is there an official open source repo for the `PyDyTuesday` python package?

Thanks.
